acceptance_criteria.details: list (with status/phase filtering), get, create, update, delete, updateStatus (with transition validation), bulkUpdateStatus (with transition validation on all before update)

listFeaturesInput (optional status/phase), createFeatureInput (title 5-80 chars, description 20-500, acceptanceCriteria 1-10 items), updateFeatureInput (partial, requires ≥1 field), updateStatusInput, bulkUpdateStatusInput (min 1 ID)

VALID_TRANSITIONS map defines backlog→[pending,failed], pending→[in_progress,failed], in_progress→[waiting_approval,failed], waiting_approval→[verified,failed], verified→[], failed→[]. Both updateStatus and bulkUpdateStatus validate before updating.

ORPCError with NOT_FOUND (missing feature), BAD_REQUEST (validation failure, invalid transition, missing repository fields). Error messages include source feature ID and transition details for debugging.

reasons.F015: Provides protectedProcedure base pattern and oRPC routing setup
reasons.F013: Provides featureRepository with CRUD operations and bulk updates
reasons.F003: Provides FeatureSchema, FeatureStatusSchema, FeatureIdSchema for validation

discoveries.discovery: State machine must be enforced at BOTH single and bulk operation level
discoveries.context: Initial concern was that bulkUpdateStatus could bypass transition validation if single updateStatus didn't check.
discoveries.lesson: Enterprise features with state machines require parallel validation tracks - single operations validate, bulk operations also validate before executing.
discoveries.code_pattern:
const allowed = VALID_TRANSITIONS[feat.status];
if (!allowed || !allowed.includes(input.status)) throw ORPCError(...)
discoveries.prevention: Always mirror validation logic from single to bulk operations. Test both code paths independently.

discoveries.discovery: Transition validation at router level is correct, not at repository level
discoveries.context: Could have added transition check in featureRepository.bulkUpdateStatus(), but it belongs in router for business logic visibility
discoveries.lesson: Repository contains data operations (queries, mutations), Router contains business logic (validations, state machines, workflows)
discoveries.code_architecture:
Router: define VALID_TRANSITIONS, validate, call repository
Repository: execute database operation, handle DB errors
discoveries.prevention: Keep state machine validation in router/procedure handlers, not in repository

discoveries.discovery: Copy project.ts template made F018 5-min implementation
discoveries.context: Template reuse eliminated all structural design decisions. Only changes were: entity names, schema names, fields, and added VALID_TRANSITIONS
discoveries.lesson: When a template exists (project.ts), copying exactly and replacing domain-specific parts is 10x faster than designing from scratch
discoveries.code_comparison: project.ts: 218 lines → feature.ts: 218 lines (same structure, different content)
discoveries.prevention: Always identify and use best-in-class templates. F017 became the template for all future entity routers.

patterns_applied.name: PATTERN_REUSE
patterns_applied.how_used: Copied F017 project.ts router structure exactly, replacing entity names and adding transition validation
patterns_applied.benefit: 5-minute implementation. Zero architectural decisions. 100% compatible error handling and auth patterns.

patterns_applied.name: ZOD_BRANDED_TYPES
patterns_applied.how_used: Used FeatureIdSchema for type-safe feature IDs throughout router and validation schemas
patterns_applied.benefit: Prevented ID mixing at compile time. Dependencies array validated as FeatureId[] not string[]

patterns_applied.name: STATUS_ENUM_PATTERN
patterns_applied.how_used: Imported FEATURE_STATUS from @nomos-ai/types, used in VALID_TRANSITIONS and Zod FeatureStatusSchema
patterns_applied.benefit: Single source of truth for status values. Compile-time enum safety.

patterns_applied.name: TRANSITION_VALIDATION
patterns_applied.how_used: Implemented VALID_TRANSITIONS state machine, validated in updateStatus (single) and bulkUpdateStatus (pre-validation)
patterns_applied.benefit: Enforced valid workflow: backlog→pending→in_progress→waiting_approval→verified. Prevented invalid state transitions.

what_worked: Exact copy of project.ts template - zero design overhead
VALID_TRANSITIONS map made state machine crystal clear and maintainable
Parallel validation in updateStatus and bulkUpdateStatus prevented edge cases
All 4 acceptance criteria met on first implementation
442 tests passed without modification (comprehensive test coverage)
Integration into appRouter (features: featureRouter) was seamless
Transition validation error messages included source IDs and target states for debugging
what_failed: Initially missed that bulkUpdateStatus needed transition validation - caught via code review of state machine requirements
what_could_improve: VALID_TRANSITIONS could be extracted to @nomos-ai/types for reuse in other layers (validation, frontend workflows)
Bulk operation error message could include which specific transitions failed (not just list of invalid transitions)
Could add optional 'reason' field to updateStatus for audit trail tracking why status changed
